note_text: SYNTHETIC DATA ONLY. Adult patient admitted for evaluation of chest discomfort after climbing stairs. Initial troponin was negative and vital signs were stable.
SYNTHETIC DATA ONLY. Chest discomfort resolved overnight. Telemetry showed no sustained arrhythmia. Plan included medication reconciliation and outpatient follow-up.
SYNTHETIC DATA ONLY. Chest CT showed no pulmonary embolism. A 4 mm right upper lobe pulmonary nodule was incidentally noted.
SYNTHETIC DATA ONLY. Discharge instructions included primary care follow-up within one week and return precautions for recurrent chest pain or shortness of breath.
